title: Project Manager (Interior Fit-Outs/Modular Furniture)
description:
Job summary This job describes an integrated model covering planning, in-house manufacturing and installation, and its case study specifically describes the project manager controlling installation against the approved floor plan, coordinating readiness, inspecting the completed installation with the client, and obtaining handover. 
 Key Responsibilities Sales-to-Project Handover - Take over confirmed PO, BOQ, quotation, approved drawings, specifications, finishes, and client commitments. Ensure complete and accurate project handover from Sales. Scope Validation - Cross-check PO, quotation, BOQ, and drawings. Identify and resolve quantity, specification, and scope discrepancies before execution. Project Kick-Off - Conduct project kick-off meetings with Sales, Design, Engineering, Purchase, Maintenance, Production, QC, Logistics, Accounts and Installation teams. Define responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables. Project Planning & Scheduling - Prepare the master project schedule based on the committed delivery and handover date. Track project milestones and overall progress. Site Survey & Verification - Coordinate site measurements and verify site conditions, access, lift, loading, flooring, electrical, and other requirements. Ensure site readiness before execution. Drawing Coordination & Approval - Coordinate preparation and approval of GFC/AFC drawings. Ensure approved drawings are available before production. Engineering Release - Coordinate detailed production drawings, BOMs, hardware, and special requirements. Ensure accurate and timely release of production information. Change & Variation Management - Control all changes and revisions through proper documentation and approvals. Evaluate impact on project cost, timeline, and resources. Material Readiness - Monitor project-specific and long-lead materials with Purchase and Planning teams. Ensure materials are available as per the project schedule. Production Planning - Coordinate production priorities based on project requirements and installation sequence. Ensure furniture is manufactured as per approved drawings and timelines. Production Monitoring - Monitor planned versus actual production progress. Follow up with Production teams and resolve delays or bottlenecks. Quality Management - Ensure pre-dispatch inspection of dimensions, finishes, hardware, quantity, and functionality. Ensure products meet approved specifications and quality standards. Client & Stakeholder Coordination - Act as the primary project contact for clients, architects, PMCs, consultants, and contractors.
